description:
Design discussion only; do not implement until the user chooses a policy.

Context:
- OM intentionally stages observations during long agent loops but does not publish or prune mid-turn because earlier mid-turn pruning caused lost working context, repeated file reads/tool work, prompt instability, and tool-call/tool-result hazards.
- On 2026-08-27, one tool-heavy autonomous turn grew to roughly 800k tokens before Pi compacted. OM's `session_before_compact` fallback preserved continuity correctly, so this is not a correctness bug in the intended normal policy.
- The event suggests an optional emergency mechanism may be useful before an exceptionally long turn reaches the model/context hard limit.

Discuss and compare opt-in designs such as:
1. A configurable emergency total-context/tool-result threshold that invokes OM-backed compaction early while leaving normal turn-boundary publication unchanged.
2. A safe agent-loop rollover: persist an OM checkpoint, terminate/settle the current loop at a tool-safe boundary, and enqueue a continuation turn with the same task guidance.
3. Emergency-only publication/pruning at a proven safe boundary, with a stable prompt generation, preserved recent working set, and strict tool-call/tool-result closure.
4. Warning/pause policies or graduated thresholds before automatic action.
5. Whether Pi-native compaction hooks provide enough control or require a small upstream/runtime seam.

Required discussion outcomes:
- preserve the default invariant: observe continuously, publish discretely; no routine mid-turn pruning;
- define trigger metrics, hysteresis, defaults, configuration, and user visibility;
- compare continuity, prompt-cache, tool-protocol, latency, and runaway-turn risks;
- choose whether the feature is disabled by default or has a conservative emergency default;
- identify tests/fault scenarios before filing implementation children.

Relevant references:
- `packages/pi-om-extension/docs/observation-timing-deviation.md`
- `packages/pi-om-extension/docs/mastra-parity-backlog.md`
- `packages/pi-om-extension/src/index.ts` (`context`, `agent_end`, `session_before_compact` lifecycle)
- Prior regression ticket `sbdpi-f51.12` for tool-call/tool-result-safe pruning.
title: Discuss opt-in emergency context controls for exceptionally long OM turns
